ko.title: 세계 원유 수송로의 톨게이트: 호르무즈 해협 재개방을 위한 이란·오만 구상의 내부

segments.src: The proposal now circulating among Gulf capitals is deceptively simple.
segments.tr: 걸프 지역 수도들 사이에서 돌고 있는 제안은 언뜻 단순해 보입니다.

segments.src: Tankers heading into the Persian Gulf would use one designated inbound lane, monitored on the Iranian side.
segments.tr: 페르시아만으로 향하는 유조선들은 이란 측에서 모니터링하는 지정된 단일 입항 차선을 이용하게 됩니다.

segments.src: Tankers heading out would use a separate lane on the Omani side.
segments.tr: 출항하는 유조선들은 오만 측의 별도 차선을 이용하게 됩니다.

segments.src: Ships would clear a joint notification system before entering, and they would pay what the framework reportedly calls a "service fee" — money described as covering escort, traffic management, spill response and environmental monitoring.
segments.tr: 선박들은 진입하기 전에 공동 통보 시스템을 거쳐야 하며, 이 프레임워크가 보도에 따르면 "서비스 수수료"라고 부르는 비용을 지불하게 됩니다. 이는 호위, 교통 관리, 유출 대응 및 환경 모니터링 비용을 충당하는 것으로 설명되는 금액입니다.

segments.src: Regional officials cited in recent reporting say the arrangement is close to final.
segments.tr: 최근 보도에서 인용된 지역 관료들은 이 합의가 최종 단계에 가까워졌다고 말합니다.

segments.src: If it holds, it would end the most disruptive interruption to global energy shipping in decades.
segments.tr: 이 구상이 유지된다면, 이는 수십 년 만에 글로벌 에너지 해상 운송에 가장 큰 혼란을 주었던 사태를 끝내게 될 것입니다.

segments.src: It would also hand Tehran something it did not have before the fighting began: a formal, revenue-generating role in managing traffic through the single most important chokepoint in the world economy.
segments.tr: 또한 이는 테헤란에게 분쟁이 시작되기 전에는 없었던 것, 즉 세계 경제의 가장 중요한 초입을 통과하는 교통을 관리하는 데 있어 공식적이고 수익을 창출하는 역할을 쥐어주게 될 것입니다.

segments.src: That is the tension at the center of this story, and it is why the plan has run into a wall in Washington.
segments.tr: 그것이 이 이야기의 중심에 있는 긴장이며, 이 계획이 워싱턴에서 난관에 부딪힌 이유입니다.

segments.src: President Donald Trump has said publicly that the United States will not accept Iran charging ships to pass.
segments.tr: 도널드 트럼프 대통령은 미국이 이란이 선박들의 통행에 대해 요금을 부과하는 것을 용납하지 않을 것이라고 공개적으로 밝혔습니다.

segments.src: The framework's supporters say the fee is a technical cost-recovery measure.
segments.tr: 이 프레임워크를 지지하는 이들은 이 수수료가 기술적인 비용 회수 조치라고 말합니다.

segments.src: Its critics say a toll is a toll, and that once it exists, it never goes away.
segments.tr: 비판론자들은 통행료는 통행료일 뿐이며, 일단 존재하게 되면 결코 사라지지 않는다고 말합니다.

segments.src: **A note on sourcing:** the details below reflect what officials and analysts have described publicly.
segments.tr: **출처에 대한 참고 사항:** 아래의 세부 사항은 관료들과 분석가들이 공개적으로 설명한 내용을 반영합니다.

segments.src: No final text has been released, and the terms could change or collapse entirely.
segments.tr: 최종 텍스트는 아직 공개되지 않았으며, 조건은 변경되거나 완전히 무산될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Readers should treat specifics as provisional.
segments.tr: 독자들은 세부 사항을 잠정적인 것으로 다루어야 합니다.

segments.src: ## Why this particular stretch of water matters so much
segments.tr: ## 이 특정한 수역이 그토록 중요한 이유

segments.src: The Strait of Hormuz is roughly 21 nautical miles across at its narrowest point — about the distance from Manhattan to the middle of Long Island.
segments.tr: 호르무즈 해협은 가장 좁은 지점이 대략 21해리(약 38.9km)로, 맨해튼에서 롱아일랜드 중부까지의 거리 정도입니다.

segments.src: The usable shipping channels are far narrower: two lanes of about two miles each, separated by a two-mile buffer, threading between Iranian waters to the north and Omani territory to the south.
segments.tr: 사용 가능한 해상 항로는 훨씬 더 좁습니다. 각각 약 2마일 너비의 두 차선이 2마일의 완충 지대로 분리되어 있으며, 북쪽의 이란 영해와 남쪽의 오만 영토 사이를 꿰뚫고 지나갑니다.

segments.src: Through that gap moves something on the order of a fifth of the world's traded oil, along with a comparable share of seaborne liquefied natural gas, most of it from Qatar.
segments.tr: 그 틈새를 통해 전 세계 거래 원유의 약 5분의 1에 달하는 물량이 이동하며, 카타르산이 대부분을 차지하는 해상 액화천연가스(LNG)의 상당한 비중도 함께 이동합니다.

segments.src: Saudi Arabia, Iraq, the UAE, Kuwait and Iran itself all ship the bulk of their crude through it.
segments.tr: 사우디아라비아, 이라크, UAE, 쿠웨이트, 그리고 이란 자신도 원유 대부분을 이 해협을 통해 선적합니다.

segments.src: There are pipeline workarounds — Saudi Arabia's East-West line to the Red Sea and the UAE's line to Fujairah — but together they can carry only a fraction of normal Hormuz volumes.
segments.tr: 파이프라인 우회로(사우디아라비아의 홍해행 동서 파이프라인과 UAE의 푸자이라행 파이프라인)가 존재하지만, 이들을 모두 합쳐도 평상시 호르무즈 물동량의 극히 일부만 운송할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: There is no substitute route.
segments.tr: 대체 경로는 없습니다.

segments.src: That single fact is what makes the strait valuable, and what makes any change to who manages it a matter of global consequence rather than regional housekeeping.
segments.tr: 그 단 하나의 사실이 이 해협을 가치 있게 만들며, 이를 관리하는 주체의 어떠한 변경도 지역적인 내부 정비가 아닌 전 세계적인 파급 효과를 지닌 사안으로 만듭니다.

segments.src: ## How the two-lane system would work
segments.tr: ## 2차선 시스템은 어떻게 작동할 것인가

segments.src: Under the framework as described, the arrangement rests on three pillars.
segments.tr: 설명된 바와 같이 프레임워크에 따르면, 이 합의는 세 가지 기둥에 기반합니다.

segments.src: **Split sovereignty over traffic.** Inbound vessels would transit a corridor supervised from the Iranian side; outbound vessels would use an Omani-supervised corridor.
segments.tr: **교통에 대한 분할 주권.** 입항 선박은 이란 측에서 감독하는 회랑을 통과하고, 출항 선박은 오만이 감독하는 회랑을 이용하게 됩니다.

segments.src: Both countries would contribute to a joint coordination cell handling vessel notifications, scheduling and incident response.
segments.tr: 양국은 선박 통보, 일정 관리 및 사고 대응을 처리하는 공동 조정 조직에 기여하게 됩니다.

segments.src: **A notification-and-clearance step.** Ships would file details in advance — flag, cargo, ownership, destination.
segments.tr: **통보 및 허가 절차.** 선박들은 국적, 화물, 소유권, 목적지 등의 세부 정보를 사전에 제출해야 합니다.

segments.src: Supporters present this as standard maritime traffic management, similar in spirit to systems used in other busy waterways.
segments.tr: 지지자들은 이를 다른 바쁜 수역에서 사용되는 시스템과 유사한 정신을 가진 표준적인 해상 교통 관리로 제시합니다.

segments.src: Skeptics note that a clearance step is also a screening step, and screening is leverage.
segments.tr: 회의론자들은 허가 절차 또한 스크리닝(선별) 절차이며, 스크리닝은 곧 레버리지(영향력)라고 지적합니다.

segments.src: **The fee.** Vessels would pay a per-transit charge, framed as compensation for security escort, navigational services and environmental protection.
segments.tr: **수수료.** 선박들은 보안 호위, 항해 서비스 및 환경 보호에 대한 보상으로 구성된 통항 당 수수료를 지불하게 됩니다.

segments.src: Reported figures have varied widely and none should be treated as settled.
segments.tr: 보도된 수치는 크게 달랐으며 어떤 것도 확정된 것으로 간주되어서는 안 됩니다.

segments.src: Oman's participation is the element that makes the package politically viable.
segments.tr: 오만의 참여는 이 패키지를 정치적으로 실현 가능하게 만드는 요소입니다.

segments.src: Muscat has spent decades as the region's quiet intermediary — on good terms with Tehran, Washington, Riyadh and others simultaneously.
segments.tr: 무스카트는 수십 년 동안 이 지역의 조용한 중개자 역할을 해왔으며, 테헤란, 워싱턴, 리야드 등과 동시에 좋은 관계를 유지해 왔습니다.

segments.src: Its presence lets shipowners and insurers describe the arrangement as multilateral rather than as an Iranian tollgate, and it gives Gulf states a counterpart they are willing to deal with.
segments.tr: 오만의 존재는 선주와 보험사들이 이 합의를 이란의 톨게이트가 아닌 다자간 합의로 묘사할 수 있게 해주며, 걸프 국가들에게는 거래할 의향이 있는 상대방을 제공합니다.

segments.src: ## The money is smaller than it sounds — and bigger
segments.tr: ## 비용은 들리는 것보다 적지만, 동시에 더 큽니다

segments.src: Run the arithmetic and the direct cost looks modest.
segments.tr: 산을 두드려보면 직접적인 비용은 그리 크지 않아 보입니다.

segments.src: A very large crude carrier holds roughly two million barrels.
segments.tr: 초대형 유조선(VLCC)은 대략 2백만 배럴을 수용합니다.

segments.src: A fee in the low hundreds of thousands of dollars spreads out to a few cents per barrel — noise against a crude price in the dollars-per-barrel swing range on any given week.
segments.tr: 수십만 달러 안팎의 수수료는 배럴당 몇 센트로 분산되며, 이는 매주 변동하는 배럴당 원유 가격 변동폭에 비하면 소음에 불과합니다.

segments.src: Charterers absorb worse every month from bunker fuel moves.
segments.tr: 용선자들은 매월 벙커유(선박 연료유) 가격 변동으로 인해 이보다 더한 타격을 흡수하고 있습니다.

segments.src: But the fee is not really where the cost lives.
segments.tr: 하지만 비용이 진정으로 머무는 곳은 수수료가 아닙니다.

segments.src: The cost lives in insurance.
segments.tr: 비용은 보험에 머뭅니다.

segments.src: War-risk premiums for Gulf transits reprice constantly against perceived threat, and during acute periods they have jumped by multiples, sometimes adding far more per voyage than any proposed service fee.
segments.tr: 걸프 지역 통항에 대한 전쟁 위험 보험료는 감지된 위협에 따라 끊임없이 재조정되며, 급박한 시기에는 몇 배로 치솟아 때로는 제안된 어떤 서비스 수수료보다 항해당 훨씬 더 많은 비용을 추가하곤 했습니다.

segments.src: If the framework genuinely stabilizes transits — if underwriters believe escorted, deconflicted passage means fewer incidents — premiums fall, and shipowners could come out ahead even after paying.
segments.tr: 만약 이 프레임워크가 통항을 진정으로 안정화한다면, 즉 언더라이터(보험 인수사)들이 호위받고 분쟁이 해소된 통항이 사고를 줄어들게 한다고 믿는다면 보험료는 하락하며, 선주들은 비용을 지불한 후에도 이익을 볼 수 있습니다.

segments.src: That is the commercial argument its backers make, and it is not a weak one.
segments.tr: 그것이 지지자들이 내세우는 상업적 논거이며, 이는 결코 약한 논거가 아닙니다.

segments.src: The counterargument is about precedent rather than price.
segments.tr: 반대 논거는 가격이 아니라 선례에 관한 것입니다.

segments.src: A fee that is small today is still a fee, and a mechanism that exists can be adjusted.
segments.tr: 오늘날 적은 수수료라 해도 여전히 수수료이며, 일단 존재하는 메커니즘은 조정될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Tie the rate to a vessel's flag, owner or destination, and a traffic-management system becomes an instrument of policy.
segments.tr: 요율을 선박의 국적, 소유주 또는 목적지와 연계하면 교통 관리 시스템은 정책의 도구가 됩니다.

segments.src: Nothing in the reported framework suggests that is the intent.
segments.tr: 보도된 프레임워크 어디에도 그것이 의도라는 시사는 없습니다.

segments.src: Nothing in it would obviously prevent it either.
segments.tr: 그렇다고 그것을 명백히 막을 수 있는 내용도 없습니다.

segments.src: ## The legal argument nobody fully wins
segments.tr: ## 아무도 온전히 승리하지 못하는 법적 논쟁

segments.src: International law treats natural straits differently from canals, and that distinction explains most of the dispute.
segments.tr: 국제법은 자연 해협을 운하와 다르게 취급하며, 그 구분이 분쟁의 대부분을 설명합니다.

segments.src: The Suez and Panama canals are engineered waterways, built and maintained by states that legitimately charge for their use.
segments.tr: 수에즈 운하와 파나마 운하는 인공 수로로, 이용료를 정당하게 부과하는 국가들이 건설하고 유지 관리합니다.

segments.src: Hormuz is a natural channel.
segments.tr: 호르무즈는 자연 해협입니다.

segments.src: Under the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea, ships enjoy a right of transit passage through straits used for international navigation, and the convention bars states bordering a strait from levying charges on foreign vessels solely for passing through.
segments.tr: 유엔 해양법 협약(UNCLOS)에 따라 선박들은 국제 항해에 사용되는 해협을 통과할 권리(통항권)를 누리며, 협약은 해협 인접 국가들이 외국 선박이 단순히 통과하는 것만을 이유로 요금을 부과하는 것을 금지합니다.

segments.src: Fees for specific services actually rendered — pilotage, salvage, traffic control — sit in a narrower and more defensible category.
segments.tr: 실제로 제공된 특정 서비스(도선, 인양, 교통 관제 등)에 대한 수수료는 더 좁고 방어 가능한 범주에 속합니다.

segments.src: The complication is that the parties do not stand on identical ground.
segments.tr: 복잡한 점은 당사자들이 동일한 입장에 서 있지 않다는 것입니다.

segments.src: Iran signed UNCLOS but never ratified it and has long maintained positions on transit rights that differ from the American reading.
segments.tr: 이란은 UNCLOS에 서명했으나 비준하지는 않았으며, 미국의 해석과 다른 통항권에 대한 입장을 오랫동안 고수해 왔습니다.

segments.src: The United States never ratified the convention either, yet treats its navigation provisions as binding customary law and has enforced that view with naval presence for decades.
segments.tr: 미국 역시 이 협약을 비준한 적이 없지만, 그 항해 조항들을 구속력 있는 관습법으로 취급하며 수십 년 동안 해군력을 동원해 그 입장을 집행해 왔습니다.

segments.src: So both sides can cite the law and mean different things.
segments.tr: 따라서 양측 모두 법을 인용하면서도 다른 의미를 담을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: There is also a partial precedent working in Tehran's favor: under the Montreux Convention, Turkey levies cost-recovery charges on ships transiting its straits for services such as lighthouses and health inspection.
segments.tr: 또한 테헤란에 유리하게 작용하는 부분적인 선례도 있습니다. 몽트뢰 협약에 따라  Türkei(튀르키예)는 등대 및 위생 검역 같은 서비스를 위해 자국 해협을 통과하는 선박에 비용 회수성 요금을 부과합니다.

segments.src: The amounts are small and the legal basis is specific, but the principle — a strait state charging for services — is established.
segments.tr: 금액은 적고 법적 근거는 구체적이지만, '해협 국가가 서비스에 대해 요금을 부과한다'는 원칙은 확립되어 있습니다.

segments.src: Expect the final text, if there is one, to be drafted with enormous care around a single word: whether the payment is for *passage* or for *services*.
segments.tr: 최종 텍스트가 나온다면, 그 대가가 *통항(passage)*에 대한 것인지 아니면 *서비스(services)*에 대한 것인지라는 단 하나의 단어를 두고 엄청난 주의를 기울여 작성될 것으로 예상하십시오.

segments.src: ## What each side gets
segments.tr: ## 각 진영이 얻는 것

segments.src: For Iran, the appeal is straightforward.
segments.tr: 이란에게 매력은 단순합니다.

segments.src: A recognized administrative role converts pressure into position, generates revenue outside sanctioned oil channels, and creates a standing arrangement that would be politically awkward to unwind later.
segments.tr: 공인된 행정적 역할은 압박을 지위로 전환하고, 제재받지 않는 원유 채널 외의 수익을 창출하며, 나중에 이를 되돌리기에는 정치적으로 껄끄러운 상시 체제를 만들어냅니다.

segments.src: For Gulf exporters, reopening restores the revenue their budgets depend on.
segments.tr: 걸프 수출국들에게는 재개방이 예산이 의존하는 수익을 복원해 줍니다.

segments.src: Extended disruption is not a tolerable equilibrium for any producer in the region, including Iran.
segments.tr: 장기화된 혼란은 이란을 포함해 그 지역의 어떤 산유국에게도 견딜 수 있는 균형 상태가 아닙니다.

segments.src: For shipowners and cargo owners, predictability is the product.
segments.tr: 선주와 화주들에게는 예측 가능성이 곧 상품입니다.

segments.src: Commercial shipping does not need a favorable outcome so much as a legible one — a known rule, a known cost, a known route.
segments.tr: 상업 해운은 유리한 결과라기보다는 알기 쉬운 결과, 즉 알려진 규칙, 알려진 비용, 알려진 경로를 필요로 합니다.

segments.src: For Washington, the calculus is harder.
segments.tr: 워싱턴에게는 셈법이 더 복잡합니다.

segments.src: Ending the disruption is a clear win.
segments.tr: 혼란을 끝내는 것은 확실한 승리입니다.

segments.src: Accepting a permanent Iranian hand on the throttle of global energy trade is a clear loss.
segments.tr: 글로벌 에너지 교역의 스로틀에 영구적인 이란의 손이 얹히는 것을 수용하는 것은 확실한 패배입니다.

segments.src: The administration's position appears to be that it can have the first without the second, which is why the fee — the smallest number in the package — has become the largest obstacle.
segments.tr: 행정부의 입장은 두 번째 것 없이 첫 번째 것을 가질 수 있다는 것으로 보이며, 이것이 바로 패키지에서 가장 작은 숫자인 수수료가 가장 큰 장애물이 된 이유입니다.

segments.src: ## What to watch
segments.tr: ## 주시해야 할 점

segments.src: - **The wording.** "Service charge" versus "transit fee" is not semantics. It determines whether the arrangement can be described as consistent with existing law.
segments.tr: - **문구.** "서비스 요금" 대 "통항 수수료"는 말장난이 아닙니다. 이 합의가 기존 법률과 일치하는 것으로 묘사될 수 있는지를 결정합니다.

segments.src: - **Who collects.** A jointly administered fund with published accounts reads very differently from direct payment to a national authority.
segments.tr: - **수금 주체.** 공개된 장부를 갖춘 공동 관리 기금은 국가 당국에 대한 직접적인 지불과는 매우 다르게 읽힙니다.

segments.src: - **Whether it is flag-blind.** A uniform charge applied to all vessels is a traffic system. A differentiated one is leverage.
segments.tr: - **국적(기종) 차별 없는 적용 여부.** 모든 선박에 균등하게 적용되는 요금은 교통 시스템입니다. 차등 적용되는 요금은 레버리지입니다.

segments.src: - **Duration and review.** A defined sunset with renewal conditions is a temporary fix. An open-ended arrangement is a new permanent feature of the map.
segments.tr: - **존속 기간 및 검토.** 갱신 조건이 포함된 명확한 일몰 조항은 임시 방편입니다. 기한이 없는 합의는 지도상의 새로운 영구적 특징이 됩니다.

segments.src: - **Insurance rates.** The most honest indicator of whether markets believe any of this will be what underwriters do with war-risk premiums, not what officials say at podiums.
segments.tr: - **보험료.** 시장이 이 중 어떤 것이라도 믿고 있는지에 대한 가장 정직한 지표는 관료들이 연단에서 하는 말이 아니라 언더라이터들이 전쟁 위험 보험료를 가지고 무엇을 하느냐입니다.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: The choice on the table is between two imperfect outcomes: a closed or unreliable strait that damages nearly everyone, or an open strait on terms that leave Tehran with more standing than it held before.
segments.tr: 테이블 위에 놓인 선택지는 두 가지 불완전한 결과 사이의 것입니다. 거의 모든 이에게 피해를 주는 폐쇄되거나 신뢰할 수 없는 해협이냐, 아니면 테헤란에게 이전보다 더 큰 지위를 남겨주는 조건의 열린 해협이냐 하는 것입니다.

segments.src: Neither is anyone's preferred result, and the negotiation is essentially about which imperfection is easier to live with.
segments.tr: 어느 쪽도 누군가가 선호하는 결과는 아니며, 협상은 본질적으로 어떤 결점이 더 살아가기 쉬운가에 관한 것입니다.

segments.src: The plan's real test is not whether it reopens the waterway.
segments.tr: 이 계획의 진정한 시험대는 수로를 다시 여느냐가 아닙니다.

segments.src: It is whether the mechanism that reopens it can be retired later — or whether the toll booth, once built, simply becomes part of the road.
segments.tr: 그것을 다시 여는 메커니즘이 나중에 철회될 수 있는지, 아니면 톨게이트가 일단 지어지면 도로의 일부가 되어버리는지의 문제입니다.

segments.src: *This article is an analytical explainer based on publicly reported information available at the time of writing.
segments.tr: *이 기사는 작성 시점에 공개적으로 보도된 정보를 바탕으로 한 분석적 해설입니다.

segments.src: Terms described here are unconfirmed and subject to change.
segments.tr: 여기서 설명된 조건들은 확정되지 않았으며 변경될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: It is not investment, legal, or operational advice.*
segments.tr: 이는 투자, 법률 또는 운영상의 조언이 아닙니다.*

zh.title: 世界石油大动脉上的收费站：伊朗与阿曼重新开放霍尔木兹海峡计划内幕

segments.src: The proposal now circulating among Gulf capitals is deceptively simple.
segments.tr: 目前在海湾各国首都流传的这项提议看似简单。

segments.src: Tankers heading into the Persian Gulf would use one designated inbound lane, monitored on the Iranian side.
segments.tr: 驶入波斯湾的油轮将使用一条指定的入境航道，由伊朗一侧进行监控。

segments.src: Tankers heading out would use a separate lane on the Omani side.
segments.tr: 驶出的油轮将使用阿曼一侧的独立航道。

segments.src: Ships would clear a joint notification system before entering, and they would pay what the framework reportedly calls a "service fee" — money described as covering escort, traffic management, spill response and environmental monitoring.
segments.tr: 船只在进入前需通过一个联合通报系统获得清关，并且它们需要支付框架据称称为“服务费”的费用——这笔钱被描述用于支付护航、交通管理、溢油响应和环境监测。

segments.src: Regional officials cited in recent reporting say the arrangement is close to final.
segments.tr: 近期报道中引用的地区官员表示，该安排已接近最后敲定。

segments.src: If it holds, it would end the most disruptive interruption to global energy shipping in decades.
segments.tr: 如果该安排得以维持，它将结束几十年来对全球能源运输最具破坏性的中断。

segments.src: It would also hand Tehran something it did not have before the fighting began: a formal, revenue-generating role in managing traffic through the single most important chokepoint in the world economy.
segments.tr: 这也将赋予德黑兰一项在战斗开始前所没有的权利：在管理全球经济中最重要的单一咽喉要道的交通方面，扮演一个正式的、产生收入的角色。

segments.src: That is the tension at the center of this story, and it is why the plan has run into a wall in Washington.
segments.tr: 这就是这个故事的核心紧张局势，也是该计划在华盛顿碰壁的原因。

segments.src: President Donald Trump has said publicly that the United States will not accept Iran charging ships to pass.
segments.tr: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普公开表示，美国不会接受伊朗对过往船只收费。

segments.src: The framework's supporters say the fee is a technical cost-recovery measure.
segments.tr: 该框架的支持者表示，这笔费用是一项技术性的成本回收措施。

segments.src: Its critics say a toll is a toll, and that once it exists, it never goes away.
segments.tr: 批评者则认为，收费就是收费，一旦它存在了，就永远不会消失。

segments.src: **A note on sourcing:** the details below reflect what officials and analysts have described publicly.
segments.tr: **关于消息来源的说明：** 以下细节反映了官员和分析人士公开描述的情况。

segments.src: No final text has been released, and the terms could change or collapse entirely.
segments.tr: 尚未发布最终文本，条款可能会更改或完全破裂。

segments.src: Readers should treat specifics as provisional.
segments.tr: 读者应将具体细节视为暂定。

segments.src: ## Why this particular stretch of water matters so much
segments.tr: ## 为什么这片特定海域如此重要

segments.src: The Strait of Hormuz is roughly 21 nautical miles across at its narrowest point — about the distance from Manhattan to the middle of Long Island.
segments.tr: 霍尔木兹海峡在其最窄处大约有21海里宽——大约是从曼哈顿到长岛中部的距离。

segments.src: The usable shipping channels are far narrower: two lanes of about two miles each, separated by a two-mile buffer, threading between Iranian waters to the north and Omani territory to the south.
segments.tr: 可用的航运通道要窄得多：两条各约两英里的航道，由一个两英里的缓冲区隔开，在北部的伊朗水域和南部的阿曼领土之间穿行。

segments.src: Through that gap moves something on the order of a fifth of the world's traded oil, along with a comparable share of seaborne liquefied natural gas, most of it from Qatar.
segments.tr: 穿过这个缺口的是大约占世界贸易石油五分之一的货物，以及相当大比例的海运液化天然气，其中大部分来自卡塔尔。

segments.src: Saudi Arabia, Iraq, the UAE, Kuwait and Iran itself all ship the bulk of their crude through it.
segments.tr: 沙特阿拉伯、伊拉克、阿联酋、科威特和伊朗本身的大部分原油都通过该海峡运送。

segments.src: There are pipeline workarounds — Saudi Arabia's East-West line to the Red Sea and the UAE's line to Fujairah — but together they can carry only a fraction of normal Hormuz volumes.
segments.tr: 虽然有替代管道——沙特阿拉伯通往红海的东西向管道和阿联酋通往富查伊拉的管道——但它们加起来只能承载正常霍尔木兹运量的一小部分。

segments.src: There is no substitute route.
segments.tr: 没有替代路线。

segments.src: That single fact is what makes the strait valuable, and what makes any change to who manages it a matter of global consequence rather than regional housekeeping.
segments.tr: 这一单一事实正是海峡的价值所在，也使得对其管理者身份的任何改变都成为具有全球影响的事，而不仅仅是地区性内务。

segments.src: ## How the two-lane system would work
segments.tr: ## 双车道系统如何运作

segments.src: Under the framework as described, the arrangement rests on three pillars.
segments.tr: 根据所描述的框架，该安排建立在三个支柱之上。

segments.src: **Split sovereignty over traffic.** Inbound vessels would transit a corridor supervised from the Iranian side; outbound vessels would use an Omani-supervised corridor.
segments.tr: **分割交通主权。** 入境船只将通过从伊朗一侧监督的走廊；出境船只将使用阿曼监督的走廊。

segments.src: Both countries would contribute to a joint coordination cell handling vessel notifications, scheduling and incident response.
segments.tr: 两国都将为一个处理船舶通报、调度和事件响应的联合协调小组做出贡献。

segments.src: **A notification-and-clearance step.** Ships would file details in advance — flag, cargo, ownership, destination.
segments.tr: **通报和清关步骤。** 船只将提前提交详细信息——船旗、货物、所有权、目的地。

segments.src: Supporters present this as standard maritime traffic management, similar in spirit to systems used in other busy waterways.
segments.tr: 支持者将其视为标准的海洋交通管理，其精神类似于其他繁忙水道中使用的系统。

segments.src: Skeptics note that a clearance step is also a screening step, and screening is leverage.
segments.tr: 怀疑论者指出，清关步骤也是审查步骤，而审查就是筹码。

segments.src: **The fee.** Vessels would pay a per-transit charge, framed as compensation for security escort, navigational services and environmental protection.
segments.tr: **费用。** 船只将支付每次过境费，被塑造成对安全护航、导航服务和环境保护的补偿。

segments.src: Reported figures have varied widely and none should be treated as settled.
segments.tr: 报道的数字差异很大，任何数字都不应被视为已确定。

segments.src: Oman's participation is the element that makes the package politically viable.
segments.tr: 阿曼的参与是使该方案在政治上可行的因素。

segments.src: Muscat has spent decades as the region's quiet intermediary — on good terms with Tehran, Washington, Riyadh and others simultaneously.
segments.tr: 马斯喀特几十年来一直是该地区的安静调解人——同时与德黑兰、华盛顿、利雅得和其他国家保持良好关系。

segments.src: Its presence lets shipowners and insurers describe the arrangement as multilateral rather than as an Iranian tollgate, and it gives Gulf states a counterpart they are willing to deal with.
segments.tr: 它的存在让船东和保险公司可以将该安排描述为多边合作，而不是伊朗的收费站，这也为海湾国家提供了一个他们愿意打交道的对话对象。

segments.src: ## The money is smaller than it sounds — and bigger
segments.tr: ## 这笔钱比听起来要少——也更多

segments.src: Run the arithmetic and the direct cost looks modest.
segments.tr: 进行算术计算，直接成本看起来并不高。

segments.src: A very large crude carrier holds roughly two million barrels.
segments.tr: 超大型原油运载船大约可装载两百万桶。

segments.src: A fee in the low hundreds of thousands of dollars spreads out to a few cents per barrel — noise against a crude price in the dollars-per-barrel swing range on any given week.
segments.tr: 区区几十万美元的费用摊开来每桶只有几美分——与任何给定周内每桶美元波动范围的原油价格相比，这微不足道。

segments.src: Charterers absorb worse every month from bunker fuel moves.
segments.tr: 承租人每个月都要承受更糟糕的船用燃料价格波动。

segments.src: But the fee is not really where the cost lives.
segments.tr: 但费用并不是成本真正所在的地方。

segments.src: The cost lives in insurance.
segments.tr: 成本在于保险。

segments.src: War-risk premiums for Gulf transits reprice constantly against perceived threat, and during acute periods they have jumped by multiples, sometimes adding far more per voyage than any proposed service fee.
segments.tr: 海湾航行的战争风险保费会根据感知到的威胁不断重新定价，在严峻时期，保费会成倍飙升，有时每次航行增加的费用远超任何提议的服务费。

segments.src: If the framework genuinely stabilizes transits — if underwriters believe escorted, deconflicted passage means fewer incidents — premiums fall, and shipowners could come out ahead even after paying.
segments.tr: 如果该框架真正稳定了航行——如果承保人认为有护航、消除冲突的通道意味着更少的事件——保费就会下降，船东甚至在支付费用后也能获利。

segments.src: That is the commercial argument its backers make, and it is not a weak one.
segments.tr: 这就是其支持者提出的商业论点，而且并非站不住脚。

segments.src: The counterargument is about precedent rather than price.
segments.tr: 反驳的论点是关于先例而不是价格。

segments.src: A fee that is small today is still a fee, and a mechanism that exists can be adjusted.
segments.tr: 今天很小的费用仍然是费用，存在的机制是可以调整的。

segments.src: Tie the rate to a vessel's flag, owner or destination, and a traffic-management system becomes an instrument of policy.
segments.tr: 将费率与船只的船旗、所有者或目的地挂钩，交通管理系统就会成为政策工具。

segments.src: Nothing in the reported framework suggests that is the intent.
segments.tr: 报道的框架中没有任何内容表明这是意图。

segments.src: Nothing in it would obviously prevent it either.
segments.tr: 其中也没有任何内容能明显阻止这一点。

segments.src: ## The legal argument nobody fully wins
segments.tr: ## 谁也无法完全获胜的法律辩论

segments.src: International law treats natural straits differently from canals, and that distinction explains most of the dispute.
segments.tr: 国际法对待自然海峡与运河的方式不同，这种区别解释了大部分争端。

segments.src: The Suez and Panama canals are engineered waterways, built and maintained by states that legitimately charge for their use.
segments.tr: 苏伊士运河和巴拿马运河是人工水道，由合法收费使用它们的国家建造和维护。

segments.src: Hormuz is a natural channel.
segments.tr: 霍尔木兹是一个自然海峡。

segments.src: Under the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea, ships enjoy a right of transit passage through straits used for international navigation, and the convention bars states bordering a strait from levying charges on foreign vessels solely for passing through.
segments.tr: 根据《联合国海洋法公约》，船只享有通过用于国际航行的海峡的过境通行权，并且该公约禁止海峡沿岸国仅以通过为由向外国船只征收费用。

segments.src: Fees for specific services actually rendered — pilotage, salvage, traffic control — sit in a narrower and more defensible category.
segments.tr: 实际提供的特定服务的费用——引航、打捞、交通管制——属于更窄且更具防御性的类别。

segments.src: The complication is that the parties do not stand on identical ground.
segments.tr: 复杂之处在于各方的立场并不完全相同。

segments.src: Iran signed UNCLOS but never ratified it and has long maintained positions on transit rights that differ from the American reading.
segments.tr: 伊朗签署了《联合国海洋法公约》但从未批准，长期以来一直坚持与美国对过境权解读不同的立场。

segments.src: The United States never ratified the convention either, yet treats its navigation provisions as binding customary law and has enforced that view with naval presence for decades.
segments.tr: 美国也从未批准该公约，却将航行条款视为具有约束力的习惯法，并几十年来一直用海军存在来执行这种观点。

segments.src: So both sides can cite the law and mean different things.
segments.tr: 因此，双方都可以引用法律并表达不同的意思。

segments.src: There is also a partial precedent working in Tehran's favor: under the Montreux Convention, Turkey levies cost-recovery charges on ships transiting its straits for services such as lighthouses and health inspection.
segments.tr: 还有一个对德黑兰有利的部分先例：根据《蒙特勒公约》，土耳其对为其海峡提供灯塔和卫生检查等服务的过往船只征收成本回收费用。

segments.src: The amounts are small and the legal basis is specific, but the principle — a strait state charging for services — is established.
segments.tr: 金额很小，法律基础也很具体，但海峡国家为服务收费的原则已经确立。

segments.src: Expect the final text, if there is one, to be drafted with enormous care around a single word: whether the payment is for *passage* or for *services*.
segments.tr: 预计最终文本（如果有的话）将围绕一个词进行极为谨慎的起草：付款是针对*通行*还是针对*服务*。

segments.src: ## What each side gets
segments.tr: ## 各方能得到什么

segments.src: For Iran, the appeal is straightforward.
segments.tr: 对伊朗而言，吸引力很简单。

segments.src: A recognized administrative role converts pressure into position, generates revenue outside sanctioned oil channels, and creates a standing arrangement that would be politically awkward to unwind later.
segments.tr: 公认的管理角色将压力转化为地位，在受制裁的石油渠道之外产生收入，并创建一个以后在政治上很难取消的常设安排。

segments.src: For Gulf exporters, reopening restores the revenue their budgets depend on.
segments.tr: 对海湾出口商而言，重新开放恢复了其预算赖以生存的收入。

segments.src: Extended disruption is not a tolerable equilibrium for any producer in the region, including Iran.
segments.tr: 对于该地区的任何产油国（包括伊朗）来说，长期中断都不是一个可以忍受的平衡。

segments.src: For shipowners and cargo owners, predictability is the product.
segments.tr: 对船东和货主而言，可预测性就是产品。

segments.src: Commercial shipping does not need a favorable outcome so much as a legible one — a known rule, a known cost, a known route.
segments.tr: 商业航运需要的与其说是一个有利的结果，不如说是一个清晰的结果——一条已知的规则、已知的成本、已知的路线。

segments.src: For Washington, the calculus is harder.
segments.tr: 对华盛顿而言，计算更为艰难。

segments.src: Ending the disruption is a clear win.
segments.tr: 结束中断是一个明显的胜利。

segments.src: Accepting a permanent Iranian hand on the throttle of global energy trade is a clear loss.
segments.tr: 接受伊朗对全球能源贸易油门进行永久性控制是一个明显的失败。

segments.src: The administration's position appears to be that it can have the first without the second, which is why the fee — the smallest number in the package — has become the largest obstacle.
segments.tr: 政府的立场似乎是它可以在没有第二个的情况下拥有第一个，这就是为什么这笔费用——方案中最小的数字——成为了最大的障碍。

segments.src: ## What to watch
segments.tr: ## 需要关注什么

segments.src: - **The wording.** "Service charge" versus "transit fee" is not semantics. It determines whether the arrangement can be described as consistent with existing law.
segments.tr: - **措辞。** “服务费”与“过境费”并非语义问题。它决定了该安排是否可以被描述为符合现有法律。

segments.src: - **Who collects.** A jointly administered fund with published accounts reads very differently from direct payment to a national authority.
segments.tr: - **谁来收取。** 设有公开账户的联合管理基金，与直接向国家当局支付有着截然不同的含义。

segments.src: - **Whether it is flag-blind.** A uniform charge applied to all vessels is a traffic system. A differentiated one is leverage.
segments.tr: - **是否对船旗盲目。** 对所有船只征收统一费用是交通系统。差异化收费则是筹码。

segments.src: - **Duration and review.** A defined sunset with renewal conditions is a temporary fix. An open-ended arrangement is a new permanent feature of the map.
segments.tr: - **期限和审查。** 具有续签条件的明确日落条款是临时解决办法。开放式安排是地图上的一个新永久特征。

segments.src: - **Insurance rates.** The most honest indicator of whether markets believe any of this will be what underwriters do with war-risk premiums, not what officials say at podiums.
segments.tr: - **保险费率。** 市场是否相信这一切的最诚实指标将是承保人如何处理战争风险保费，而不是官员在讲台上说的话。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 底线

segments.src: The choice on the table is between two imperfect outcomes: a closed or unreliable strait that damages nearly everyone, or an open strait on terms that leave Tehran with more standing than it held before.
segments.tr: 摆在台面上的选择是两个不完美的结果之间做出抉择：一个损害几乎所有人且封闭或不可靠的海峡，或者一个以让德黑兰获得比以往更高地位为条件的开放海峡。

segments.src: Neither is anyone's preferred result, and the negotiation is essentially about which imperfection is easier to live with.
segments.tr: 两者都不是任何人首选的结果，谈判本质上是关于哪种缺陷更容易忍受。

segments.src: The plan's real test is not whether it reopens the waterway.
segments.tr: 该计划真正的考验不是它是否重新开放了水道。

segments.src: It is whether the mechanism that reopens it can be retired later — or whether the toll booth, once built, simply becomes part of the road.
segments.tr: 而是重新开放它的机制以后是否可以退役——或者收费站一旦建成，就会成为道路的一部分。

hi.title: विश्व के तेल राजमार्ग पर एक टोल बूथ: होर्मुज को फिर से खोलने की ईरान-ओमान योजना के अंदर

segments.src: The proposal now circulating among Gulf capitals is deceptively simple.
segments.tr: खाड़ी की राजधानियों के बीच प्रसारित होने वाला प्रस्ताव पहली नज़र में सरल लगता है।

segments.src: Tankers heading into the Persian Gulf would use one designated inbound lane, monitored on the Iranian side.
segments.tr: फारस की खाड़ी में जाने वाले टैंकर एक निश्चित इनबाउंड लेन का उपयोग करेंगे, जिसकी निगरानी ईरानी पक्ष से की जाएगी।

segments.src: Tankers heading out would use a separate lane on the Omani side.
segments.tr: बाहर जाने वाले टैंकर ओमान की तरफ़ एक अलग लेन का उपयोग करेंगे।

segments.src: Ships would clear a joint notification system before entering, and they would pay what the framework reportedly calls a "service fee" — money described as covering escort, traffic management, spill response and environmental monitoring.
segments.tr: प्रवेश करने से पहले जहाज़ एक संयुक्त अधिसूचना प्रणाली से गुज़रेंगे, और वे उस चीज़ का भुगतान करेंगे जिसे ढांचा कथित तौर पर "सेवा शुल्क" कहता है — ऐसा धन जिसे एस्कॉर्ट, ट्रैफिक प्रबंधन, रिसाव प्रतिक्रिया और पर्यावरण की निगरानी को कवर करने के रूप में वर्णित किया गया है।

segments.src: Regional officials cited in recent reporting say the arrangement is close to final.
segments.tr: हाल की रिपोर्टों में उद्धृत क्षेत्रीय अधिकारियों का कहना है कि यह व्यवस्था अंतिम रूप के करीब है।

segments.src: If it holds, it would end the most disruptive interruption to global energy shipping in decades.
segments.tr: यदि यह टिकती है, तो यह दशकों में वैश्विक ऊर्जा नौवहन में सबसे विघटनकारी रुकावट को समाप्त कर देगी।

segments.src: It would also hand Tehran something it did not have before the fighting began: a formal, revenue-generating role in managing traffic through the single most important chokepoint in the world economy.
segments.tr: यह तेहरान को वह चीज़ भी सौंप देगी जो लड़ाई शुरू होने से पहले उसके पास नहीं थी: दुनिया की अर्थव्यवस्था के सबसे महत्वपूर्ण चोकपॉइंट के माध्यम से यातायात के प्रबंधन में एक औपचारिक, राजस्व पैदा करने वाली भूमिका।

segments.src: That is the tension at the center of this story, and it is why the plan has run into a wall in Washington.
segments.tr: यह इस कहानी के केंद्र में तनाव है, और यही कारण है कि यह योजना वाशिंगटन में एक दीवार से टकरा गई है।

segments.src: President Donald Trump has said publicly that the United States will not accept Iran charging ships to pass.
segments.tr: राष्ट्रपति डोनाल्ड ट्रम्प ने सार्वजनिक रूप से कहा है कि संयुक्त राष्ट्र अमेरिका ईरान द्वारा गुज़रने के लिए जहाज़ों से शुल्क वसूलने को स्वीकार नहीं करेगा।

segments.src: The framework's supporters say the fee is a technical cost-recovery measure.
segments.tr: इस ढांचे के समर्थकों का कहना है कि यह शुल्क लागत वसूली का एक तकनीकी उपाय है।

segments.src: Its critics say a toll is a toll, and that once it exists, it never goes away.
segments.tr: इसके आलोचकों का कहना है कि एक टोल, टोल ही होता है, और एक बार जब यह अस्तित्व में आ जाता है, तो यह कभी समाप्त नहीं होता है।

segments.src: **A note on sourcing:** the details below reflect what officials and analysts have described publicly.
segments.tr: **स्रोतों पर एक नोट:** नीचे दिए गए विवरण उन बातों को दर्शाते हैं जिन्हें अधिकारियों और विश्लेषकों ने सार्वजनिक रूप से वर्णित किया है।

segments.src: No final text has been released, and the terms could change or collapse entirely.
segments.tr: कोई अंतिम पाठ जारी नहीं किया गया है, और शर्तें बदल सकती हैं या पूरी तरह से ढह सकती हैं।

segments.src: Readers should treat specifics as provisional.
segments.tr: पाठकों को विशिष्टताओं को अनंतिम मानना चाहिए।

segments.src: ## Why this particular stretch of water matters so much
segments.tr: ## पानी का यह विशेष हिस्सा इतना महत्वपूर्ण क्यों है

segments.src: The Strait of Hormuz is roughly 21 nautical miles across at its narrowest point — about the distance from Manhattan to the middle of Long Island.
segments.tr: होर्मुज जलडमरूमध्य अपने सबसे संकीर्ण बिंदु पर लगभग 21 समुद्री मील चौड़ा है — लगभग मैनहट्टन से लॉन्ग द्वीप के मध्य की दूरी के बराबर।

segments.src: The usable shipping channels are far narrower: two lanes of about two miles each, separated by a two-mile buffer, threading between Iranian waters to the north and Omani territory to the south.
segments.tr: उपयोग योग्य शिपिंग चैनल बहुत संकीर्ण हैं: लगभग दो-दो मील के दो लेन, जिन्हें दो मील के बफर द्वारा अलग किया गया है, जो उत्तर में ईरानी जल और दक्षिण में ओमान के क्षेत्र के बीच से गुजरते हैं।

segments.src: Through that gap moves something on the order of a fifth of the world's traded oil, along with a comparable share of seaborne liquefied natural gas, most of it from Qatar.
segments.tr: उस अंतराल से दुनिया के कारोबार में आने वाले तेल का लगभग पांचवां हिस्सा गुजरता है, साथ ही कतर से आने वाले समुद्री तरलीकृत प्राकृतिक गैस का एक तुलनीय हिस्सा भी शामिल है।

segments.src: Saudi Arabia, Iraq, the UAE, Kuwait and Iran itself all ship the bulk of their crude through it.
segments.tr: सउदी अरब, इराक, संयुक्त अरब अमीरात, कुवैत और खुद ईरान अपने कच्चे तेल का अधिकांश हिस्सा इसी के माध्यम से भेजते हैं।

segments.src: There are pipeline workarounds — Saudi Arabia's East-West line to the Red Sea and the UAE's line to Fujairah — but together they can carry only a fraction of normal Hormuz volumes.
segments.tr: यहाँ पाइपलाइन के विकल्प मौजूद हैं — लाल सागर के लिए सउदी अरब की पूर्व-पश्चिम लाइन और फुजैराह के लिए संयुक्त अरब अमीरात की लाइन — लेकिन वे मिलकर सामान्य होर्मुज मात्रा का केवल एक अंश ही ले जा सकती हैं।

segments.src: There is no substitute route.
segments.tr: इसका कोई वैकल्पिक मार्ग नहीं है।

segments.src: That single fact is what makes the strait valuable, and what makes any change to who manages it a matter of global consequence rather than regional housekeeping.
segments.tr: यह अकेला तथ्य जलडमरूमध्य को मूल्यवान बनाता है, और जो इसे प्रबंधित करने वाले किसी भी बदलाव को क्षेत्रीय गृहस्थी के बजाय वैश्विक परिणाम का मामला बनाता है।

segments.src: ## How the two-lane system would work
segments.tr: ## दो-लेन प्रणाली कैसे काम करेगी

segments.src: Under the framework as described, the arrangement rests on three pillars.
segments.tr: वर्णित ढांचे के तहत, व्यवस्था तीन स्तंभों पर टिकी है।

segments.src: **Split sovereignty over traffic.** Inbound vessels would transit a corridor supervised from the Iranian side; outbound vessels would use an Omani-supervised corridor.
segments.tr: **यातायात पर विभाजित संप्रभुता।** आने वाले जहाज़ ईरानी पक्ष से पर्यवेक्षित एक गलियारे से गुजरेंगे; बाहर जाने वाले जहाज़ ओमान-पर्यवेक्षित गलियारे का उपयोग करेंगे।

segments.src: Both countries would contribute to a joint coordination cell handling vessel notifications, scheduling and incident response.
segments.tr: दोनों देश जहाज़ की सूचनाओं, शेड्यूलिंग और घटना प्रतिक्रिया को संभालने वाली एक संयुक्त समन्वय सेल में योगदान देंगे।

segments.src: **A notification-and-clearance step.** Ships would file details in advance — flag, cargo, ownership, destination.
segments.tr: **एक अधिसूचना और निकासी चरण।** जहाज़ पहले से ही विवरण दाखिल करेंगे — झंडा, कार्गो, स्वामित्व, गंतव्य।

segments.src: Supporters present this as standard maritime traffic management, similar in spirit to systems used in other busy waterways.
segments.tr: समर्थक इसे मानक समुद्री यातायात प्रबंधन के रूप में प्रस्तुत करते हैं, जो भावना में अन्य व्यस्त जलमार्गों में उपयोग की जाने वाली प्रणालियों के समान है।

segments.src: Skeptics note that a clearance step is also a screening step, and screening is leverage.
segments.tr: संदेहवादी ध्यान देते हैं कि निकासी चरण भी एक स्क्रीनिंग चरण है, और स्क्रीनिंग ही उत्तोलन है।

segments.src: **The fee.** Vessels would pay a per-transit charge, framed as compensation for security escort, navigational services and environmental protection.
segments.tr: **शुल्क।** जहाज़ प्रति पारगमन शुल्क का भुगतान करेंगे, जिसे सुरक्षा एस्कॉर्ट, नेविगेशनल सेवाओं और पर्यावरण संरक्षण के लिए मुआवजे के रूप में तैयार किया गया है।

segments.src: Reported figures have varied widely and none should be treated as settled.
segments.tr: रिपोर्ट किए गए आंकड़े व्यापक रूप से भिन्न रहे हैं और किसी को भी तय नहीं माना जाना चाहिए।

segments.src: Oman's participation is the element that makes the package politically viable.
segments.tr: ओमान की भागीदारी वह तत्व है जो पैकेज को राजनीतिक रूप से व्यावहारिक बनाती है।

segments.src: Muscat has spent decades as the region's quiet intermediary — on good terms with Tehran, Washington, Riyadh and others simultaneously.
segments.tr: मस्कट ने क्षेत्र के शांत मध्यस्थ के रूप में दशकों बिताए हैं — तेहरान, वाशिंगटन, रियाद और अन्य के साथ एक साथ अच्छे संबंधों में।

segments.src: Its presence lets shipowners and insurers describe the arrangement as multilateral rather than as an Iranian tollgate, and it gives Gulf states a counterpart they are willing to deal with.
segments.tr: इसकी उपस्थिति से जहाज मालिकों और बीमाकर्ताओं को व्यवस्था को ईरानी टोलगेट के बजाय बहुपक्षीय के रूप में वर्णित करने की अनुमति मिलती है, और यह खाड़ी देशों को एक ऐसा समकक्ष देता है जिसके साथ वे सौदा करने को तैयार हैं।

segments.src: ## The money is smaller than it sounds — and bigger
segments.tr: ## पैसा जितना लगता है उससे कम है — और बड़ा भी

segments.src: Run the arithmetic and the direct cost looks modest.
segments.tr: गणित चलाएं और प्रत्यक्ष लागत मामूली दिखाई देती है।

segments.src: A very large crude carrier holds roughly two million barrels.
segments.tr: एक बहुत बड़े कच्चे तेल के वाहक में लगभग दो मिलियन बैरल होते हैं।

segments.src: A fee in the low hundreds of thousands of dollars spreads out to a few cents per barrel — noise against a crude price in the dollars-per-barrel swing range on any given week.
segments.tr: कुछ सौ हजार डॉलर के निचले स्तर का शुल्क प्रति बैरल कुछ सेंट तक फैल जाता है — किसी भी सप्ताह में प्रति-बैरल-स्विंग रेंज में कच्चे तेल की कीमत के खिलाफ शोर।

segments.src: Charterers absorb worse every month from bunker fuel moves.
segments.tr: चार्टरर बंकर ईंधन चालों से हर महीने बदतर स्थिति को सहते हैं।

segments.src: But the fee is not really where the cost lives.
segments.tr: लेकिन शुल्क वास्तव में वह जगह नहीं है जहाँ लागत रहती है।

segments.src: The cost lives in insurance.
segments.tr: लागत बीमा में रहती है।

segments.src: War-risk premiums for Gulf transits reprice constantly against perceived threat, and during acute periods they have jumped by multiples, sometimes adding far more per voyage than any proposed service fee.
segments.tr: खाड़ी पारगमन के लिए युद्ध-जोखिम प्रीमियम कथित खतरे के खिलाफ लगातार मूल्य बदलते हैं, और तीव्र अवधि के दौरान वे कई गुना बढ़ गए हैं, कभी-कभी किसी भी प्रस्तावित सेवा शुल्क की तुलना में प्रति यात्रा बहुत अधिक जोड़ते हैं।

segments.src: If the framework genuinely stabilizes transits — if underwriters believe escorted, deconflicted passage means fewer incidents — premiums fall, and shipowners could come out ahead even after paying.
segments.tr: यदि ढांचा वास्तव में पारगमन को स्थिर करता है — यदि हामी भरने वालों का मानना है कि एस्कॉर्ट किया गया, संघर्ष-मुक्त मार्ग का मतलब कम घटनाएं हैं — तो प्रीमियम गिरते हैं, और भुगतान करने के बाद भी जहाज मालिक आगे आ सकते हैं।

segments.src: That is the commercial argument its backers make, and it is not a weak one.
segments.tr: यह वह व्यावसायिक तर्क है जिसे इसके समर्थक बनाते हैं, और यह कमजोर नहीं है।

segments.src: The counterargument is about precedent rather than price.
segments.tr: प्रतिवाद कीमत के बजाय मिसाल के बारे में है।

segments.src: A fee that is small today is still a fee, and a mechanism that exists can be adjusted.
segments.tr: आज जो शुल्क छोटा है वह अभी भी एक शुल्क है, और जो तंत्र मौजूद है उसे समायोजित किया जा सकता है।

segments.src: Tie the rate to a vessel's flag, owner or destination, and a traffic-management system becomes an instrument of policy.
segments.tr: दर को जहाज़ के झंडे, मालिक या गंतव्य से बांधें, और एक यातायात-प्रबंधन प्रणाली नीति का एक साधन बन जाती है।

segments.src: Nothing in the reported framework suggests that is the intent.
segments.tr: रिपोर्ट किए गए ढांचे में ऐसा कुछ भी नहीं है जो यह सुझाव दे कि यही इरादा है।

segments.src: Nothing in it would obviously prevent it either.
segments.tr: इसमें ऐसा कुछ भी नहीं है जो स्पष्ट रूप से इसे रोकेगा भी।

segments.src: ## The legal argument nobody fully wins
segments.tr: ## कानूनी तर्क जिसे कोई पूरी तरह से नहीं जीतता

segments.src: International law treats natural straits differently from canals, and that distinction explains most of the dispute.
segments.tr: अंतरराष्ट्रीय कानून प्राकृतिक जलडमरूमध्य को नहरों से अलग मानता है, और यह अंतर अधिकांश विवाद की व्याख्या करता है।

segments.src: The Suez and Panama canals are engineered waterways, built and maintained by states that legitimately charge for their use.
segments.tr: स्वेज और पनामा नहरें इंजीनियर जलमार्ग हैं, जिन्हें उन राज्यों द्वारा बनाया और बनाए रखा गया है जो उनके उपयोग के लिए वैध रूप से शुल्क लेते हैं।

segments.src: Hormuz is a natural channel.
segments.tr: होर्मुज एक प्राकृतिक चैनल है।

segments.src: Under the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea, ships enjoy a right of transit passage through straits used for international navigation, and the convention bars states bordering a strait from levying charges on foreign vessels solely for passing through.
segments.tr: समुद्र के कानून पर संयुक्त राष्ट्र कन्वेंशन के तहत, जहाज़ अंतरराष्ट्रीय नेविगेशन के लिए उपयोग किए जाने वाले जलडमरूमध्य के माध्यम से पारगमन मार्ग के अधिकार का आनंद लेते हैं, और कन्वेंशन जलडमरूमध्य की सीमा से लगे राज्यों को केवल पार करने के लिए विदेशी जहाजों पर शुल्क लगाने से रोकता है।

segments.src: Fees for specific services actually rendered — pilotage, salvage, traffic control — sit in a narrower and more defensible category.
segments.tr: वास्तव में प्रदान की जाने वाली विशिष्ट सेवाओं के लिए शुल्क — पायलटिज़, साल्वेज, ट्रैफिक कंट्रोल — एक संकीर्ण और अधिक रक्षात्मक श्रेणी में बैठते हैं।

segments.src: The complication is that the parties do not stand on identical ground.
segments.tr: जटिलता यह है कि पार्टियां समान जमीन पर खड़ी नहीं हैं।

segments.src: Iran signed UNCLOS but never ratified it and has long maintained positions on transit rights that differ from the American reading.
segments.tr: ईरान ने UNCLOS पर हस्ताक्षर किए लेकिन कभी इसकी पुष्टि नहीं की और लंबे समय से पारगमन अधिकारों पर ऐसी स्थिति बनाए रखी है जो अमेरिकी पढ़ने से अलग है।

segments.src: The United States never ratified the convention either, yet treats its navigation provisions as binding customary law and has enforced that view with naval presence for decades.
segments.tr: संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका ने भी कभी कन्वेंशन की पुष्टि नहीं की, फिर भी इसके नेविगेशन प्रावधानों को बाध्यकारी प्रथागत कानून के रूप में मानता है और दशकों से नौसेना की उपस्थिति के साथ उस दृष्टिकोण को लागू किया है।

segments.src: So both sides can cite the law and mean different things.
segments.tr: इसलिए दोनों पक्ष कानून का हवाला दे सकते हैं और अलग-अलग अर्थ निकाल सकते हैं।

segments.src: There is also a partial precedent working in Tehran's favor: under the Montreux Convention, Turkey levies cost-recovery charges on ships transiting its straits for services such as lighthouses and health inspection.
segments.tr: तेहरान के पक्ष में काम करने वाली एक आंशिक मिसाल भी है: मोंट्रेक्स कन्वेंशन के तहत, तुर्की लाइटहाउस और स्वास्थ्य निरीक्षण जैसी सेवाओं के लिए अपने जलडमरूमध्य से पारगमन करने वाले जहाजों पर लागत वसूली शुल्क लगाता है।

segments.src: The amounts are small and the legal basis is specific, but the principle — a strait state charging for services — is established.
segments.tr: मात्राएँ छोटी हैं और कानूनी आधार विशिष्ट है, लेकिन सिद्धांत — सेवाओं के लिए शुल्क लेने वाला एक जलडमरूमध्य राज्य — स्थापित है।

segments.src: Expect the final text, if there is one, to be drafted with enormous care around a single word: whether the payment is for *passage* or for *services*.
segments.tr: अंतिम पाठ की अपेक्षा करें, यदि कोई है, तो एक ही शब्द के इर्द-गिर्द अत्यधिक सावधानी के साथ तैयार किया जाएगा: क्या भुगतान *पारगमन* के लिए है या *सेवाओं* के लिए।

segments.src: ## What each side gets
segments.tr: ## प्रत्येक पक्ष को क्या मिलता है

segments.src: For Iran, the appeal is straightforward.
segments.tr: ईरान के लिए, अपील सीधी है।

segments.src: A recognized administrative role converts pressure into position, generates revenue outside sanctioned oil channels, and creates a standing arrangement that would be politically awkward to unwind later.
segments.tr: एक मान्यता प्राप्त प्रशासनिक भूमिका दबाव को स्थिति में बदल देती है, स्वीकृत तेल चैनलों के बाहर राजस्व उत्पन्न करती है, और एक स्थायी व्यवस्था बनाती है जिसे बाद में राजनीतिक रूप से खोलना अजीब होगा।

segments.src: For Gulf exporters, reopening restores the revenue their budgets depend on.
segments.tr: खाड़ी निर्यातकों के लिए, फिर से खोलना उस राजस्व को पुनर्स्थापित करता है जिस पर उनके बजट निर्भर करते हैं।

segments.src: Extended disruption is not a tolerable equilibrium for any producer in the region, including Iran.
segments.tr: विस्तारित व्यवधान क्षेत्र के किसी भी निर्माता, जिसमें ईरान भी शामिल है, के लिए सहन करने योग्य संतुलन नहीं है।

segments.src: For shipowners and cargo owners, predictability is the product.
segments.tr: जहाज मालिकों और कार्गो मालिकों के लिए, पूर्वानुमेयता ही उत्पाद है।

segments.src: Commercial shipping does not need a favorable outcome so much as a legible one — a known rule, a known cost, a known route.
segments.tr: वाणिज्यिक शिपिंग को अनुकूल परिणाम की उतनी आवश्यकता नहीं है जितनी कि सुपाठ्य परिणाम की — एक ज्ञात नियम, एक ज्ञात लागत, एक ज्ञात मार्ग।

segments.src: For Washington, the calculus is harder.
segments.tr: वाशिंगटन के लिए, गणना कठिन है।

segments.src: Ending the disruption is a clear win.
segments.tr: व्यवधान को समाप्त करना एक स्पष्ट जीत है।

segments.src: Accepting a permanent Iranian hand on the throttle of global energy trade is a clear loss.
segments.tr: वैश्विक ऊर्जा व्यापार के थ्रॉटल पर एक स्थायी ईरानी हाथ को स्वीकार करना एक स्पष्ट हार है।

segments.src: The administration's position appears to be that it can have the first without the second, which is why the fee — the smallest number in the package — has become the largest obstacle.
segments.tr: प्रशासन की स्थिति यह प्रतीत होती है कि वह दूसरे के बिना पहला हो सकता है, यही कारण है कि शुल्क — पैकेज में सबसे छोटी संख्या — सबसे बड़ी बाधा बन गया है।

segments.src: ## What to watch
segments.tr: ## क्या देखना है

segments.src: - **The wording.** "Service charge" versus "transit fee" is not semantics. It determines whether the arrangement can be described as consistent with existing law.
segments.tr: - **शब्दावली।** "सेवा शुल्क" बनाम "पारगमन शुल्क" शब्दार्थ नहीं है। यह निर्धारित करता है कि क्या व्यवस्था को मौजूदा कानून के अनुरूप वर्णित किया जा सकता है।

segments.src: - **Who collects.** A jointly administered fund with published accounts reads very differently from direct payment to a national authority.
segments.tr: - **कौन एकत्र करता है।** प्रकाशित खातों वाला एक संयुक्त रूप से प्रशासित फंड राष्ट्रीय प्राधिकरण को प्रत्यक्ष भुगतान से बहुत अलग पढ़ता है।

segments.src: - **Whether it is flag-blind.** A uniform charge applied to all vessels is a traffic system. A differentiated one is leverage.
segments.tr: - **क्या यह ध्वज-अंधा है।** सभी जहाजों पर लागू एक समान शुल्क एक यातायात प्रणाली है। एक विभेदित एक उत्तोलन है।

segments.src: - **Duration and review.** A defined sunset with renewal conditions is a temporary fix. An open-ended arrangement is a new permanent feature of the map.
segments.tr: - **अवधि और समीक्षा।** नवीनीकरण शर्तों के साथ एक परिभाषित सूर्यास्त एक अस्थायी सुधार है। एक खुली व्यवस्था मानचित्र की एक नई स्थायी विशेषता है।

segments.src: - **Insurance rates.** The most honest indicator of whether markets believe any of this will be what underwriters do with war-risk premiums, not what officials say at podiums.
segments.tr: - **बीमा दरें।** इस बात का सबसे ईमानदार संकेतक कि क्या बाजारों का मानना है कि इनमें से कोई भी पोडियम पर अधिकारियों के कहने के विपरीत, वार-स्क्रीम प्रीमियम के साथ हामी भरने वाले क्या करेंगे।

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## निचला रेखा

segments.src: The choice on the table is between two imperfect outcomes: a closed or unreliable strait that damages nearly everyone, or an open strait on terms that leave Tehran with more standing than it held before.
segments.tr: मेज पर विकल्प दो अपूर्ण परिणामों के बीच है: एक बंद या अविश्वसनीय जलडमरूमध्य जो लगभग सभी को नुकसान पहुँचाता है, या ऐसी शर्तों पर एक खुला जलडमरूमध्य जो तेहरान को उसके पास पहले से अधिक स्थिति में छोड़ देता है।

segments.src: Neither is anyone's preferred result, and the negotiation is essentially about which imperfection is easier to live with.
segments.tr: न तो किसी का पसंदीदा परिणाम है, और बातचीत अनिवार्य रूप से इस बारे में है कि किस खामी के साथ जीना आसान है।

segments.src: The plan's real test is not whether it reopens the waterway.
segments.tr: योजना की वास्तविक परीक्षा यह नहीं है कि यह जलमार्ग को फिर से खोलती है या नहीं।

segments.src: It is whether the mechanism that reopens it can be retired later — or whether the toll booth, once built, simply becomes part of the road.
segments.tr: यह यह है कि क्या इसे फिर से खोलने वाला तंत्र बाद में सेवानिवृत्त हो सकता है — या क्या टोल बूथ, एक बार निर्मित होने के बाद, बस सड़क का हिस्सा बन जाता है।

segments.src: *This article is an analytical explainer based on publicly reported information available at the time of writing.
segments.tr: *यह लेख लेखन के समय उपलब्ध सार्वजनिक रूप से रिपोर्ट की गई जानकारी पर आधारित एक विश्लेषणात्मक व्याख्याकार है।

segments.src: Terms described here are unconfirmed and subject to change.
segments.tr: यहाँ वर्णित शर्तें अनिश्चित हैं और परिवर्तन के अधीन हैं।

segments.src: It is not investment, legal, or operational advice.*
segments.tr: यह निवेश, कानूनी या परिचालन सलाह नहीं है।*

es.title: Una cabina de peaje en la autopista petrolera del mundo: Inside the Iran–Oman Plan to Reopen Hormuz

segments.src: The proposal now circulating among Gulf capitals is deceptively simple.
segments.tr: La propuesta que circula actualmente entre las capitales del Golfo es engañosamente simple.

segments.src: Tankers heading into the Persian Gulf would use one designated inbound lane, monitored on the Iranian side.
segments.tr: Los petroleros que se dirijan al Golfo Pérsico utilizarían un carril de entrada designado, supervisado desde el lado iraní

segments.src: Tankers heading out would use a separate lane on the Omani side.
segments.tr: Los petroleros que salgan utilizarían un carril separado en el lado omaní.

segments.src: Ships would clear a joint notification system before entering, and they would pay what the framework reportedly calls a "service fee" — money described as covering escort, traffic management, spill response and environmental monitoring.
segments.tr: Los barcos pasarían por un sistema de notificación conjunto antes de entrar, y pagarían lo que el marco supuestamente llama una "tarifa de servicio", dinero descrito como destinado a cubrir la escolta, la gestión del tráfico, la respuesta a derrames y el monitoreo ambiental.

segments.src: Regional officials cited in recent reporting say the arrangement is close to final.
segments.tr: Funcionarios regionales citados en informes recientes dicen que el acuerdo está cerca de finalizar.

segments.src: If it holds, it would end the most disruptive interruption to global energy shipping in decades.
segments.tr: Si se mantiene, pondría fin a la interrupción más disruptiva del transporte energético global en décadas.

segments.src: It would also hand Tehran something it did not have before the fighting began: a formal, revenue-generating role in managing traffic through the single most important chokepoint in the world economy.
segments.tr: También daría a Teherán algo que no tenía antes de que comenzaran los combates: un papel formal y generador de ingresos en la gestión del tráfico a través del punto de estrangulamiento más importante de la economía mundial.

segments.src: That is the tension at the center of this story, and it is why the plan has run into a wall in Washington.
segments.tr: Esa es la tensión en el centro de esta historia, y es la razón por la cual el plan ha chocado contra un muro en Washington.

segments.src: President Donald Trump has said publicly that the United States will not accept Iran charging ships to pass.
segments.tr: El presidente Donald Trump ha dicho pùblicamente que Estados Unidos no aceptará que Irán cobre a los barcos por pasar.

segments.src: The framework's supporters say the fee is a technical cost-recovery measure.
segments.tr: Los defensores del marco dicen que la tarifa es una medida técnica de recuperación de costos.

segments.src: Its critics say a toll is a toll, and that once it exists, it never goes away.
segments.tr: Sus críticos dicen que un peaje es un peaje, y que una vez que existe, nunca desaparece.

segments.src: **A note on sourcing:** the details below reflect what officials and analysts have described publicly.
segments.tr: **Una nota sobre las fuentes:** los detalles a continuación reflejan lo que los funcionarios y analistas han descrito pùblicamente.

segments.src: No final text has been released, and the terms could change or collapse entirely.
segments.tr: No se ha publicado ningún texto final, y los términos podrían cambiar o colapsar por completo.

segments.src: Readers should treat specifics as provisional.
segments.tr: Los lectores deben tratar los detalles como provisionales.

segments.src: ## Why this particular stretch of water matters so much
segments.tr: ## Por qué este tramo particular de agua es tan importante

segments.src: The Strait of Hormuz is roughly 21 nautical miles across at its narrowest point — about the distance from Manhattan to the middle of Long Island.
segments.tr: El estrecho de Ormuz tiene aproximadamente 21 millas náuticas de ancho en su punto más estrecho, aproximadamente la distancia desde Manhattan hasta la mitad de Long Island.

segments.src: The usable shipping channels are far narrower: two lanes of about two miles each, separated by a two-mile buffer, threading between Iranian waters to the north and Omani territory to the south.
segments.tr: Los canales de navegación utilizables son mucho más estrechos: dos carriles de aproximadamente dos millas cada uno, separados por una zona amortiguadora de dos millas, que se entrelazan entre las aguas iraníes al norte y el territorio omaní al sur.

segments.src: Through that gap moves something on the order of a fifth of the world's traded oil, along with a comparable share of seaborne liquefied natural gas, most of it from Qatar.
segments.tr: A través de ese hueco se mueve algo del orden de una quinta parte del petróleo comercializado en el mundo, junto con una cuota comparable de gas natural licuado transportado por mar, la mayor parte proveniente de Qatar.

segments.src: Saudi Arabia, Iraq, the UAE, Kuwait and Iran itself all ship the bulk of their crude through it.
segments.tr: Arabia Saudí, Irak, los Emiratos Árabes Unidos, Kuwait e el mismo Irán envían la mayor parte de su crudo a través de él.

segments.src: There are pipeline workarounds — Saudi Arabia's East-West line to the Red Sea and the UAE's line to Fujairah — but together they can carry only a fraction of normal Hormuz volumes.
segments.tr: Existen alternativas de oleoductos, como la línea Este-Oeste de Arabia Saudí hacia el Mar Rojo y la línea de los EAU hacia Fujairah, pero juntos solo pueden transportar una fracción de los volûmenes normales de Ormuz.

segments.src: There is no substitute route.
segments.tr: No hay ruta sustituta.

segments.src: That single fact is what makes the strait valuable, and what makes any change to who manages it a matter of global consequence rather than regional housekeeping.
segments.tr: Ese hecho ùnico es lo que hace que el estrecho sea valioso, y lo que hace que cualquier cambio en quien lo gestione sea un asunto de consecuencia global en lugar de un simple mantenimiento regional.

segments.src: ## How the two-lane system would work
segments.tr: ## Cómo funcionaría el sistema de dos carriles

segments.src: Under the framework as described, the arrangement rests on three pillars.
segments.tr: Bajo el marco descrito, el acuerdo se basa en tres pilares.

segments.src: **Split sovereignty over traffic.** Inbound vessels would transit a corridor supervised from the Iranian side; outbound vessels would use an Omani-supervised corridor.
segments.tr: **Soberanía dividida sobre el tráfico.** Los buques entrantes transitarían por un corredor supervisado desde el lado iraní; los buques salientes utilizarían un corredor supervisado por Omán.

segments.src: Both countries would contribute to a joint coordination cell handling vessel notifications, scheduling and incident response.
segments.tr: Ambos países contribuirían a una célula de coordinación conjunta que se encargaría de las notificaciones de los buques, la programación y la respuesta a incidentes.

segments.src: **A notification-and-clearance step.** Ships would file details in advance — flag, cargo, ownership, destination.
segments.tr: **Un paso de notificación y autorización.** Los barcos presentarían los detalles con anticipación: bandera, carga, propiedad, destino.

segments.src: Supporters present this as standard maritime traffic management, similar in spirit to systems used in other busy waterways.
segments.tr: Los defensores presentan esto como una gestión estándar del tráfico marítimo, similar en espírítu a los sistemas utilizados en otras vías navegables concurridas.

segments.src: Skeptics note that a clearance step is also a screening step, and screening is leverage.
segments.tr: Los escépticos señalan que un paso de autorización es también un paso de filtrado, y el filtrado es una herramienta de presión.

segments.src: **The fee.** Vessels would pay a per-transit charge, framed as compensation for security escort, navigational services and environmental protection.
segments.tr: **La tarifa.** Los buques pagarían un cargo por tránsito, planteado como compensación por escolta de seguridad, servicios de navegación y protección ambiental.

segments.src: Reported figures have varied widely and none should be treated as settled.
segments.tr: Las cifras reportadas han variado ampliamente y ninguna debe considerarse definitiva.

segments.src: Oman's participation is the element that makes the package politically viable.
segments.tr: La participación de Omán es el elemento que hace que el paquete sea políticamente viable.

segments.src: Muscat has spent decades as the region's quiet intermediary — on good terms with Tehran, Washington, Riyadh and others simultaneously.
segments.tr: Mascate ha pasado décadas como el intermediario silencioso de la región, manteniendo buenas relaciones con Teherán, Washington, Riad y otros simultáneamente.

segments.src: Its presence lets shipowners and insurers describe the arrangement as multilateral rather than as an Iranian tollgate, and it gives Gulf states a counterpart they are willing to deal with.
segments.tr: Su presencia permite que los armadores y aseguradores describan el acuerdo como multilateral en lugar de como un peaje iraní, y da a los estados del Golfo una contraparte con la que están dispuestos a tratar.

segments.src: ## The money is smaller than it sounds — and bigger
segments.tr: ## El dinero es menor de lo que parece, y a la vez mayor

segments.src: Run the arithmetic and the direct cost looks modest.
segments.tr: Si se hacen los cálculos, el costo directo parece modesto.

segments.src: A very large crude carrier holds roughly two million barrels.
segments.tr: Un petrolero de crudo muy grande transporta aproximadamente dos millones de barriles.

segments.src: A fee in the low hundreds of thousands of dollars spreads out to a few cents per barrel — noise against a crude price in the dollars-per-barrel swing range on any given week.
segments.tr: Una tarifa de unos pocos cientos de miles de dólares se distribuye en unos pocos centavos por barril, un ruido insignificante frente a la oscilación del precio del crudo en dólares por barril en cualquier semana dada.

segments.src: Charterers absorb worse every month from bunker fuel moves.
segments.tr: Los fletadores absorben cosas peores cada mes debido a los movimientos del combustible bûnker.

segments.src: But the fee is not really where the cost lives.
segments.tr: Pero la tarifa no es realmente donde reside el costo.

segments.src: The cost lives in insurance.
segments.tr: El costo reside en el seguro.

segments.src: War-risk premiums for Gulf transits reprice constantly against perceived threat, and during acute periods they have jumped by multiples, sometimes adding far more per voyage than any proposed service fee.
segments.tr: Las primas de riesgo de guerra para los tránsitos por el Golfo se reajustan constantemente frente a la amenaza percibida, y durante periodos agudos han saltado multiplicadas, a veces añadiendo mucho más por viaje que cualquier tarifa de servicio propuesta.

segments.src: If the framework genuinely stabilizes transits — if underwriters believe escorted, deconflicted passage means fewer incidents — premiums fall, and shipowners could come out ahead even after paying.
segments.tr: Si el marco estabiliza genuinamente los tránsitos, si los aseguradores creen que el paso escoltado y sin conflictos significa menos incidentes, las primas bajan y los armadores podrían salir ganando incluso despues de pagar.

segments.src: That is the commercial argument its backers make, and it is not a weak one.
segments.tr: Ese es el argumento comercial que presentan sus defensores, y no es un argumento débil.

segments.src: The counterargument is about precedent rather than price.
segments.tr: El contraargumento se refiere al precedente más que al precio.

segments.src: A fee that is small today is still a fee, and a mechanism that exists can be adjusted.
segments.tr: Una tarifa que es pequeña hoy sigue siendo una tarifa, y un mecanismo que existe puede ser ajustado.

segments.src: Tie the rate to a vessel's flag, owner or destination, and a traffic-management system becomes an instrument of policy.
segments.tr: Si se vincula la tarifa a la bandera, el propietario o el destino del buque, un sistema de gestión del tráfico se convierte en un instrumento de política.

segments.src: Nothing in the reported framework suggests that is the intent.
segments.tr: Nada en el marco reportado sugiere que esa sea la intención.

segments.src: Nothing in it would obviously prevent it either.
segments.tr: Tampoco hay nada en él que lo impida obviamente.

segments.src: ## The legal argument nobody fully wins
segments.tr: ## El argumento legal que nadie gana por completo

segments.src: International law treats natural straits differently from canals, and that distinction explains most of the dispute.
segments.tr: El derecho internacional trata los estrechos naturales de manera diferente a los canales, y esa distinción explica la mayor parte de la disputa.

segments.src: The Suez and Panama canals are engineered waterways, built and maintained by states that legitimately charge for their use.
segments.tr: Los canales de Suez y Panamá son vías navegables diseñadas, construidas y mantenidas por estados que cobran legítimamente por su uso.

segments.src: Hormuz is a natural channel.
segments.tr: Ormuz es un canal natural.

segments.src: Under the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea, ships enjoy a right of transit passage through straits used for international navigation, and the convention bars states bordering a strait from levying charges on foreign vessels solely for passing through.
segments.tr: Bajo la Convención de las Naciones Unidas sobre el Derecho del Mar, los barcos gozan de un derecho de paso en tránsito a través de estrechos utilizados para la navegación internacional, y la convención prohíbe a los estados ribereños de un estrecho imponer cargos a los buques extranjeros solo por pasar a través.

segments.src: Fees for specific services actually rendered — pilotage, salvage, traffic control — sit in a narrower and more defensible category.
segments.tr: Las tarifas por servicios específicos realmente prestados, como el practicaje, el salvamento y el control del tráfico, entran en una categoría más estrecha y más defendible.

segments.src: The complication is that the parties do not stand on identical ground.
segments.tr: La complicación es que las partes no se encuentran en una posición idéntica.

segments.src: Iran signed UNCLOS but never ratified it and has long maintained positions on transit rights that differ from the American reading.
segments.tr: Irán firmó la UNCLOS pero nunca la ratificó y ha mantenido durante mucho tiempo posiciones sobre los derechos de tránsito que difieren de la lectura estadounidense.

segments.src: The United States never ratified the convention either, yet treats its navigation provisions as binding customary law and has enforced that view with naval presence for decades.
segments.tr: Estados Unidos tampoco ratificó la convención, pero trata sus disposiciones de navegación como derecho consuetudinario vinculante y ha impuesto esa visión con presencia naval durante décadas.

segments.src: So both sides can cite the law and mean different things.
segments.tr: Por lo tanto, ambos lados pueden citar la ley y referirse a cosas diferentes.

segments.src: There is also a partial precedent working in Tehran's favor: under the Montreux Convention, Turkey levies cost-recovery charges on ships transiting its straits for services such as lighthouses and health inspection.
segments.tr: También hay un precedente parcial que favorece a Teherán: bajo la Convención de Montreux, Turquía impone cargos de recuperación de costos a los barcos que transitan por sus estrechos por servicios como faros e inspección de salud.

segments.src: The amounts are small and the legal basis is specific, but the principle — a strait state charging for services — is established.
segments.tr: Los montos son pequeños y la base legal es específica, pero el principio, que un estado del estrecho cobre por servicios, está establecido.

segments.src: Expect the final text, if there is one, to be drafted with enormous care around a single word: whether the payment is for *passage* or for *services*.
segments.tr: Se espera que el texto final, si lo hay, sea redactado con enorme cuidado en torno a una sola palabra: si el pago es por *paso* o por *servicios*.

segments.src: ## What each side gets
segments.tr: ## Lo que obtiene cada lado

segments.src: For Iran, the appeal is straightforward.
segments.tr: Para Irán, el atractivo es sencillo.

segments.src: A recognized administrative role converts pressure into position, generates revenue outside sanctioned oil channels, and creates a standing arrangement that would be politically awkward to unwind later.
segments.tr: Un papel administrativo reconocido convierte la presión en posición, genera ingresos fuera de los canales petroleros sancionados y crea un acuerdo permanente que sería políticamente incómodo de deshacer más tarde.

segments.src: For Gulf exporters, reopening restores the revenue their budgets depend on.
segments.tr: Para los exportadores del Golfo, la reapertura restaura los ingresos de los que dependen sus presupuestos.

segments.src: Extended disruption is not a tolerable equilibrium for any producer in the region, including Iran.
segments.tr: Una interrupción prolongada no es un equilibrio tolerable para ningón productor de la región, incluido Irán.

segments.src: For shipowners and cargo owners, predictability is the product.
segments.tr: Para los armadores y dueños de la carga, la predictibilidad es el producto.

segments.src: Commercial shipping does not need a favorable outcome so much as a legible one — a known rule, a known cost, a known route.
segments.tr: El transporte comercial no necesita un resultado favorable tanto como uno legible: una regla conocida, un costo conocido, una ruta conocida.

segments.src: For Washington, the calculus is harder.
segments.tr: Para Washington, el cálculo es más difícil.

segments.src: Ending the disruption is a clear win.
segments.tr: Terminar con la interrupción es una victoria clara.

segments.src: Accepting a permanent Iranian hand on the throttle of global energy trade is a clear loss.
segments.tr: Aceptar una mano iraní permanente en el acelerador del comercio energético global es una derrota clara.

segments.src: The administration's position appears to be that it can have the first without the second, which is why the fee — the smallest number in the package — has become the largest obstacle.
segments.tr: La posición de la administración parece ser que puede obtener lo primero sin lo segundo, que es por lo que la tarifa, el nûmero más pequeño del paquete, se ha convertido en el obstáculo más grande.

segments.src: ## What to watch
segments.tr: ## Qué observar

segments.src: - **The wording.** "Service charge" versus "transit fee" is not semantics. It determines whether the arrangement can be described as consistent with existing law.
segments.tr: - **La redacción.** "Cargo por servicio" frente a "tarifa de tránsito" no es semántica. Determina si el acuerdo puede describirse como coherente con la ley existente.

segments.src: - **Who collects.** A jointly administered fund with published accounts reads very differently from direct payment to a national authority.
segments.tr: - **Quien recauda.** Un fondo administrado conjuntamente con cuentas publicadas se lee muy diferente de un pago directo a una autoridad nacional.

segments.src: - **Whether it is flag-blind.** A uniform charge applied to all vessels is a traffic system. A differentiated one is leverage.
segments.tr: - **Si es ciego a la bandera.** Un cargo uniforme aplicado a todos los buques es un sistema de tráfico. Uno diferenciado es una herramienta de presión.

segments.src: - **Duration and review.** A defined sunset with renewal conditions is a temporary fix. An open-ended arrangement is a new permanent feature of the map.
segments.tr: - **Duración y revisión.** Un plazo de vencimiento definido con condiciones de renovación es una solución temporal. Un acuerdo sin plazos es una nueva característica permanente del mapa.

segments.src: - **Insurance rates.** The most honest indicator of whether markets believe any of this will be what underwriters do with war-risk premiums, not what officials say at podiums.
segments.tr: - **Tasas de seguro.** El indicador más honesto de si los mercados creen en algo de esto será lo que los aseguradores hagan con las primas de riesgo de guerra, no lo que los funcionarios digan en los podios.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Conclusión

segments.src: The choice on the table is between two imperfect outcomes: a closed or unreliable strait that damages nearly everyone, or an open strait on terms that leave Tehran with more standing than it held before.
segments.tr: La opción sobre la mesa es entre dos resultados imperfectos: un estrecho cerrado o poco fiable que daña a casi todos, o un estrecho abierto en términos que dejan a Teherán con más peso que el que tenía antes.

segments.src: Neither is anyone's preferred result, and the negotiation is essentially about which imperfection is easier to live with.
segments.tr: Ninguno es el resultado preferido de nadie, y la negociación se trata esencialmente de quál imperfección es más fácil de soportar.

segments.src: The plan's real test is not whether it reopens the waterway.
segments.tr: La verdadera prueba del plan no es si reapertura la vóa navegable.

segments.src: It is whether the mechanism that reopens it can be retired later — or whether the toll booth, once built, simply becomes part of the road.
segments.tr: Es si el mecanismo que la reapertura puede ser retirado más tarde, o si la cabina de peaje, una vez construida, simplemente se convierte en parte de la carretera.
